moderation.responseHint: What Niko does with a message that uses a blocked word
moderation.maskHint: Replaces each blocked word; a single character repeats to match its length
moderation.censorNoteBefore: Censoring deletes the flagged message and reposts the text through a webhook in that channel using the member's name and avatar, so Niko needs
moderation.censorNoteAfter: in the channels you want censored. If the webhook cannot be created the message is deleted instead.
moderation.matchNoteBefore: Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, like Discord: blocking
moderation.matchNoteMiddle: leaves “category” alone. End a word with
moderation.matchNoteAnywhere: to match it anywhere. Separators between letters are ignored, so
moderation.presetsDetail: Turn on ready-made filters for slurs and other content. Each one is a regular expression, so it also catches the spellings people use to slip past a word list.
moderation.presetsUnavailable: Preset filters are unavailable right now — reload the page to try again.
moderation.presetsNote: Presets run with the same response as the word list above: delete the message, or censor and repost it. They are regular expressions rather than plain keywords, so they also tolerate leet substitutions, letters separated by spaces or punctuation, repeated letters, self-censored letters, look-alike unicode characters and fullwidth forms — while leaving ordinary words such as “class”, “analysis” and “spices” untouched. Matching is deliberately aggressive: a term is blocked wherever it stands on its own, so a place name that looks like one trips the slur preset.
